seed_schedule_note: 20220207 is the seed the 2026-07-23 C2D4 run used; the two successors are its immediate increments. The three seeds exist only to measure the sampler's own log-evidence scatter, which enters the acceptance test as a numerical uncertainty. Chosen by this lane as a reversible default and recorded here so it is reproducible.
shared_zeta_note: the driver passes no --per-band-zeta flag; because every rung is multi-component the runner sets the effective shared_zeta to false on its own, which is what the contract must record
identical_across_rungs: both input waterfalls and their hashes
the bad-channel masks and surviving frequency channels
the fitted window in each band
the prior version and every prior endpoint
the environment lock and the runtime environment identity
every executed source file and the source revision

resolution_contract.owner_selection: DSA-110 at 65.536 microseconds; CHIME/FRB at its existing prepared resolution
resolution_contract.status: RESOLVED - owner accepted 65.536 microseconds after visual comparison and requested the component-count experiment
resolution_contract.note: the resolution must be identical across all 27 rungs or the comparison is void
resolution_contract.decision_evidence: Owner statement in the controlling conversation: the 32.768- and 65.536-microsecond profiles looked almost identical and 65 microseconds was acceptable; the owner then requested this component-count experiment. The profile diagnostic at docs/rse/verify/zach-dsa-resolution-comparison-20260730/ is criterion-dependent and does not itself determine the fitted component count.

acceptance.evidence_rule: accept a step from N to N+1 only if the log-evidence improvement exceeds 5 with the same sign at every fixed gain-prior variance, after subtracting twice the combined numerical uncertainty (the sampler's reported error added in quadrature with the standard deviation across the three seeds)
reject_if: any run fails to reach the stopping threshold or has an incomplete output set
any component's posterior arrival time falls outside its band's fitted window
neighbouring counts occupy different scattering modes (non-overlapping pulse-broadening exponent posteriors, or a posterior against a prior edge)
an added component has null or unbounded amplitude, or does not coincide with an owner-identified candidate feature
local residuals do not improve where the component was added
per-band visual residual diagnostics are unacceptable in either band
acceptance.on_statistical_failure: the owner-confirmed morphology stands as recorded; fitted parameters and count evidence remain unaccepted. C2D3 is not reinstated as physical.
acceptance.downstream_hold: scattering time times scintillation bandwidth stays downstream of fit acceptance
acceptance.inner_scale_power_law_model: conditional sensitivity test only, at a single accepted count, and only if the canonical fit retains tail-shaped residuals or boundary behaviour. Never mixed into component-count evidence.
